title: Arizona Innovation Map
subtitle: Semiconductor supply chain × commercial districts, brought together in one innovation map.
html:
Open Arizona Innovation Map ↗

Bring industries and places into one view

Arizona Innovation Map brings semiconductor supply-chain companies, commercial districts, and institutional locations into one spatial interface. A map and list help readers identify nodes, compare their locations, and decide where to investigate next.

Three primary layers

Supply chain: filter companies by manufacturing and packaging, materials and gases, equipment and process support, specialized logistics, components, and fab engineering.

Commerce: explore brands and business locations by commercial district.

Institutions: explore education and government nodes. Layers can be combined and read alongside the list and individual location details.

Interaction and research path

Choose layers and filters, select a location from the map or list, then review its information and sources. Return to Arizona Chip Journey for process context, or open Ecosystem Network for a broader view of sectors and enabling layers.

Why this structure matters

The map turns scattered locations into spatial context that can support further industry research and business-opportunity assessment. Proximity or membership in the same sector does not establish a supplier, customer, or partnership relationship.
